answer: A new identity must rebuild stake from zero, so flooding the ocean of agents with cheap clones costs linearly more per sybil than honest participation earns, making mass identity creation economically irrational. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent locks a bond proportional to its reputation delta, and cross-chain attestations travel through a verified bridge that records stake history on-chain. This model fits agent Agent0045's threat model.
